title: Faster Chaitin-like Register Allocation via Grammatical Decompositions of Control-Flow Graphs
problem: Register allocation via graph coloring (Chaitin-style) is NP-hard in general, but practical compilers rely on heuristics that do not exploit the sparse, structured nature of real program control-flow graphs (CFGs). This leads to suboptimal allocation or unnecessary spills in programs with structured control flow.
motivation: CFGs of structured programs have bounded treewidth/pathwidth, and exploiting this structure enables faster parameterized graph-coloring algorithms that improve allocation quality or speed in practice.
method: The paper formalizes the sparsity of structured program CFGs using graph-theoretic parameters (treewidth, pathwidth) and introduces a grammatical decomposition—parsing the CFG into a tree decomposition. Register allocation is then solved efficiently via dynamic programming on this tree decomposition, yielding a parameterized algorithm whose complexity scales with the treewidth of the CFG rather than graph size alone. This exploits the observation that real programs' CFGs have small treewidth, making previously intractable exact or near-exact coloring feasible.
key_novelty: Leveraging grammatical (tree) decompositions of CFGs to design faster parameterized register allocation algorithms that exploit the bounded treewidth of structured program control flow.
contributions: Formal characterization of structured program CFGs via treewidth and pathwidth bounds
Grammatical decomposition framework for CFGs enabling dynamic-programming-based register allocation
Faster Chaitin-like register allocation algorithm with complexity parameterized by CFG treewidth
Extension of parameterized algorithm techniques from model checking/program analysis to register allocation

metrics.other: faster parameterized register allocation via treewidth-bounded CFG decomposition

limitations: Practical speedup over state-of-the-art heuristic allocators on real benchmarks is not quantified in the abstract.
primary_theme: parameterized register allocation via CFG treewidth decomposition
